mu_name_from: MuMain's MODEL_PHANTOM_* (_enum.h: MODEL_GLOVE + 48), loaded from Data/Player/GloveMale49.bmd by the index-plus-one rule. MU's number 48; ours is *Male49.
why_this_one: The missing-gear audit, 2026-10-22: one set a class at drop levels 93-132 (the user: 'Then one set per class at 93-132: Brave, Faith, Hades and Phantom'). Phantom is the Magic Gladiator's.

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (0.75 and 0.95d have none).
stats.class_level_note: OpenMU's magicGladiatorClassLevel 1, its only class. No helm: MuMain loads none for this set.

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py under MU's own names, lower-cased: red lacquer on dark steel, edged in silver. The pants carry the sheet twice, Item402_Pants.OZJ and .OZT (the .OZT has no cut: 0% under 128), both opaque.
material_note: plate_steel, as Destroy: Phantom's paint reflects as coloured steel rather than lacquer (the user, 2026-10-23: 'i think MG metal could be more metaalic no?', then all three of his lacquered sets).
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_PHANTOM_* (no glow, no chrome pass). Its full-set bonus is not given: sim::setDefense counts only Storm Crow and Hurricane for the Magic Gladiator.
